new_value: {"notes":"Fixed app_identity's invalid link-time dependencies on CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS and CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6 by deriving canonical SHA-512 IID/Yggdrasil addresses in its own always-built source. Removed optional coap_keys test dependency; added fixed IID/Ygg vectors and explicit IPv6-off/on Twister cases (ipv6_on.conf). Local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 evidence: IPv6 off CONFIG unset, compile/link PASS, runtime 6/6 PASS; IPv6 on CONFIG=y, compile/link PASS, runtime 6/6 PASS. Builds used only -Wno-error=duplicated-branches to bypass a Zephyr-4.1 cbprintf false positive in unrelated shared link/L2 logging; app_identity itself compiled under project strict warnings. nm confirmed app_identity archive has neither lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid nor lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 undefined in either configuration. git diff --check PASS; Twister listed both net.lichen.app_identity.ipv6_off/on."}

Kconfig now selects Monocypher because app_identity directly uses its constant-time compare and SHA-512. Removed optional coap_keys test dependency; added fixed IID/Ygg vectors and explicit IPv6-off/on Twister cases via ipv6_on.conf. Local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 evidence: IPv6 off (# CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6 is not set), compile/link PASS and runtime 6/6 PASS; IPv6 on (CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6=y), compile/link PASS and runtime 6/6 PASS. Reconfigured/relinked both after final Kconfig change. Builds used only -Wno-error=duplicated-branches to bypass a Zephyr-4.1 cbprintf false positive in unrelated shared link/L2 logging; app_identity compiled under project strict warnings. nm confirmed app_identity has neither lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid nor lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519 undefined in either configuration. Twister discovery lists 12 cases (6 per feature configuration). git diff --check PASS."}
